scripts.schema: node -e "require('dotenv').config(); const {Pool}=require('pg'); const fs=require('fs'); const p=new Pool({connectionString:process.env.DATABASE_URL,ssl:{rejectUnauthorized:false}}); p.query(fs.readFileSync('schema.sql','utf8')).then(()=>{console.log('Schema applied');p.end()}).catch(e=>{console.error(e.message);p.end()});"
